# roadie_context_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie context group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_context_group" "existing" {
  slug = "services-and-teams"
}

output "context_group_name" {
  value = data.roadie_context_group.existing.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID. Provide either id or slug.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifier. Provide either id or slug.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `include_external_relations` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `seed_version` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
